predicate_baseline: Amendment Plan v1.1 canonical predicates; code from des.py

derivability_class_definitions.strict-derived: O_i ⊨ G_j AND Σ guarantees T_j selection
derivability_class_definitions.guard-derived: O_i ⊨ G_j but selection not guaranteed
derivability_class_definitions.state-dependent-causal: (O_i ∧ S_k) ⊨ G_j; requires additional state condition S_k
derivability_class_definitions.not-derived: no consistent implication chain from O_i to G_j

consistency_values.trivial: Phase 1 triage: trivial-not-derived; no Phase 2 analysis needed
consistency_values.aligned: Spec-side and code-side reach same derivability class
consistency_values.divergent: Spec-side and code-side diverge in derivability class or selection_status

d_membership_rule.definition: D = { (T_i, T_j) | derivability_class ∈ {strict-derived, guard-derived, state-dependent-causal} AND uncertainty_flag ∈ {null, spec_silent, spec_underspecified} }
d_membership_rule.uncertainty_handling: uncertainty_flag is informational annotation; does not exclude from D if derivability_class is positive
